title: D1: Decide multiclassing support scope for the engine
description: 8 rule procedures (channel-divinity, class-features, extra-attack, hit-points-and-hit-dice, multiclassing, multiclassing-proficiency-bonus, spellcasting, unarmored-defense) plus experience-points' multiclass clause are design-blocked because packages/core/src/character/levelUpEngine.ts is single-class by design. Decide: is multiclassing in scope for v1? If yes, this becomes an engine epic of its own (per docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2026-07-06-o9bd-18-7-8-execution-boundary-classification.md §4 D1).
design: ADR 0018 explicitly defers multiclassing from the current v1 executable domain. Schema-v1 is single-class; level equals total and sole-class level. Runtime and creation must fail closed through a shared validator. F4/F7/F8 depend on the enforcement bead and may rely on the equality only after validation.
acceptance_criteria: A durable ADR chooses a clear multiclass support boundary and covers representation, level semantics, proficiency/HP/Hit Dice/saves/grants/equipment, features/subclasses/prerequisites, Spellcasting/Pact Magic, creation/advancement, pack/compiler needs, compatibility, and failure behavior; F4/F7/F8 contracts and sequencing are explicit; non-duplicate implementation work is represented and dependency-wired; relevant docs/tests/checks pass; bead is closed only after artifacts and beads are pushed.
close_reason: Accepted ADR 0018: current v1 engine is explicitly single-class; multiclassing is deferred behind a fail-closed shared validator. F4/F7/F8 contracts and dependencies updated, and enforcement is tracked by eshyra-2n1t.13.
